changelog: Redesigned the Series Rating Graph with a new IMDb rating source.
Added smoother animations and transitions across the app.
Added a new keyboard shortcuts system for faster navigation.
Improved Lists with a cleaner design and better interactions.
Improved News, Discover, and Search for a smoother experience.
Added pagination and improved loading states for News.
Added a new View More option for media rows.
Improved overall performance, responsiveness, and stability.

features.title: What's New
items: Added a new global keyboard shortcuts system.
Added a dedicated Shortcuts section to view available shortcuts.
Redesigned the Series Rating Graph with IMDb ratings.
Added a new View More option to Media Rows.
Added smoother page transitions and loading animations.

features.title: Better Experience
items: Improved the Series Rating Graph with smoother transitions and animations.
Improved News with better navigation, loading states, and pagination.
Improved Lists with a cleaner design and smoother interactions.
Improved animations and scrolling throughout the application.
Added a new optimized starry background.
Improved the overall responsiveness and visual experience.

features.title: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed duplicate content appearing in some sections.
Fixed animation issues when changing content.
Fixed trailer sections not displaying correctly in some cases.
Fixed multiple UI, layout, and navigation issues.
